title: Airy Guest House in Heart of East Nashville!
description:
Enjoy a relaxing visit to Music City at our upstairs studio guest house, located a five minute walk to Five Points. We are less than two miles from Downtown/Lower Broadway, 15 minute drive to Opry Mills and a few minutes drive to Shelby Park.
This is a super walkable neighborhood, just a few blocks from some of the city's best destinations: Margot, Lockeland Table, Bongo Java, Frothy Monkey, Snooze, Five Points Pizza, etc!
No check out chores!
Happy to help with celebrations or welcome baskets!
